name: bash-allowed
why: A tester's Bash call that touches no production host is allowed: nothing on stdout.

name: bash-denied
why: A tester's Bash call naming the production host gets the exact deny JSON.

name: write-protected
why: A Write to the project's .env.local gets the exact deny JSON, path included.

name: recorded-tool
why: A tool the hook only records (TodoWrite) answers nothing.

name: bash-not-json
why: A truncated payload on a Bash call inside a run answers nothing today; pinned.

name: outside-run
why: Outside a factory run the hook answers nothing, even for a call it would deny inside one.
